run_protobuf_benchmark: run a Python protobuf benchmark on data files to measure parse and serialize throughput in MB/s
run_parse_benchmark: run the parse_from_benchmark test to measure protobuf deserialization throughput for a dataset file
run_serialize_benchmark: run the serialize_to_benchmark test to measure protobuf serialization throughput for a dataset file
create_benchmark_util: create a Benchmark instance with module, setup method, and total bytes to time test functions
init_benchmark_dataset: init a benchmark dataset by parsing a protobuf file and selecting the correct message class
